no significant association was observed between the investigated DNA repair polymorphisms and the occurrence of CLL in the Chernobyl clean-up workers, except the possible protective role of the Lys751GIn XPD variant.

there are some differences between the groups of patients and control subjects in the distribution of DNA repair gene polymorphism.
the Lys751GIn XPD polymorphism is a risk factor for the development of the B-cell chronic lymphoid leukemia in persons exposed to ionizing radiation.
